_doc: A remote page survives a dropped link: it pulls from the new connection, whose hub starts from a white screen.

remote.resynced.why: the page started over with the new connection, and after the unlock

remote.offline_shown.why: while the link was gone the page said so

hub.remote.sessions.why: announced again after the outage, opened again after the unlock

remote.updates.why: the first page, the page after reconnecting, the link tapped after that, the page after the unlock

hub.remote.link_hits.why: the tap after reconnecting reached a link

remote.feedback_restored.why: the spot goes back: with the update, and by itself where no update came

rt.closed.why: the voice turn's session, the page's when the device locked and when it was closed
